title: Donor 1 iNOA
extract_protocol_ch1: Fresh testes parenchyma was washed twice in PBS and subjected to enzymatic digestion (collagenase type I, collagenase type IV, hyaluronidase, trypsin, Deoxyribonuclease I; all enzymes at 1 mg/ml in DMEM-F12 without serum) for 10 minutes at 37Â°C with gentle agitation, repeated twice (1ml of digestion medium each time). The cell suspension was filtered through strainers with mesh size 70Âµm, washed twice with 0.4% BSA/PBS and filtered through a 40Âµm cell strainer to obtain single cell.,Chromium Single Cell 3â€² Library & Gel Bead Kit v2 kit (10xGenomics).
data_processing: FASTQ files were demultiplexed from the raw base call (BCL) files using 10x Genomics 'cellranger demux' (CellRanger v3.0.2).,The whitelist of cell barcodes was identified with 'umi_tools whitelist --set-cell-number N --bc-pattern=CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCNNNNNNNNNNNN' (umi_tools v1.0.0); with N = 2000 for donor1 and donor2, 5000 for donor3 and 1500 for donorOA.,Reads of the whitelisted cells were extracted with 'umi_tools extract --bc-pattern=CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCNNNNNNNNNNNN --filter-cell-barcode --whitelist=whitelist.txt' (umi_tools v1.0.0).,Extracted reads were aligned with STAR aligner (v2.5.3a) to the primary assembly of human genome (GRCh38) with parameter '--outFilterMultimapNmax 1' (to exclude multi-mapping reads).,Mapped reads were assigned to gene_name attributes from GENCODE basic annotation for GRCh38 (version 31) using Subread featureCounts (v1.6.4). Results were save in BAM files with option 'featureCounts -R BAM' and succesively sorted and indexed with samtools (v1.9).,Per gene counts were summarized for each cell using 'umi_tools count --per-gene --gene-tag=XT --assigned-status-tag=XS --per-cell' (umi_tools v1.0.0).,Genome_build: hg38 (GRCh38 - v31),Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Tab separated files of raw counts;  table with three columns: the gene_id, the cell barcode and the count of deduplicated UMIs. One file per sample, gzipped (.gz).
